purpose.zh: 右手承重侧撑中控制髋部下沉与抬回，练肩部和躯干稳定
purpose.en: Control hip lowering and return in a right-hand-supported side plank to practise shoulder and trunk stability.

text.zh: 右手推地保持肩部稳定，髋部缓慢下沉再抬回
text.en: Push through your right hand to keep the shoulder steady as your hips lower and rise slowly

text.zh: 右手与双脚保持原支点，左手轻扶髋部
text.en: Keep the right hand and both feet at their supports, with the left hand resting lightly on the hip.

text.zh: 承重肩远离耳朵，控制下沉幅度，不塌进肩膀
text.en: Keep the supporting shoulder away from the ear and control the dip without collapsing into the shoulder.

text.zh: 髋部慢慢抬回原位，保持呼吸，不猛扭身体
text.en: Lift the hips slowly back to the starting height, keep breathing and avoid jerking the trunk.

commonErrors.zh: 承重肩塌陷或耸肩，支撑手脚滑动
commonErrors.en: Collapsing or shrugging the supporting shoulder, or letting the support hand or feet slide.

commonErrors.zh: 甩髋、过度下沉或扭腰来抢回高度
commonErrors.en: Throwing the hips, dipping too far or twisting the waist to regain height.

items.zh: 右肩、肘与手腕：保持稳定推地的承重位置，不通过塌肩或手腕疼痛继续。
items.en: Right shoulder, elbow and wrist: maintain steady support without continuing through a collapsed shoulder or painful wrist.

items.zh: 躯干与髋：下沉范围以稳定可控为准，持续自然呼吸。
items.en: Trunk and hips: keep the dip stable and controlled while breathing naturally.

items.zh: 本动作引发疼痛时停止，不通过增加幅度或负重继续；先向医生或物理治疗师确认。
items.en: Stop if this exercise causes pain; do not add range or load before seeking clinical advice.

items.zh: 已有医嘱限制单手上肢承重、侧撑或髋部侧向控制时，先取得许可。
items.en: Obtain clearance first if single-arm upper-limb loading, side planking or lateral hip control has been restricted.

definition.countingSemantics: The native8-second v7 source shows two right-support hip dips, with lowest hip points at2.1 and5.9 seconds and high returns at3.6 and7.4. Inter-dip spacing is not exactly4 seconds. Preserve3 sets x25 seconds and legacy range; a timed dynamic hip-dip interpretation versus the old generic side-plank hold wording needs editorial approval. Right is the supporting/working shoulder side, left hand rests on the hip. No in-clip side change or mirrored media is produced.
definition.movementSides: Right hand supports the body and both feet remain planted; the left hand rests on the hip. Complete the agreed side dose before any external side change.
editorialNotes: 源是保留sideplank-v7/__pose6求解器的动态hip dip，不是单一25秒静止pose；拟名补充髋下沉，稳定ID不改，名称和处方仍待编辑审定。
右手承重、左手叉髋；不要把bakeHands left误认成左侧支撑，也不因新手掌厚度改右手free或移锁。
clothSink0、left bakeHands与solverArgs全部保留；v2plus模型如何旁路旧bake由冻结模型代码决定，不重写。
rotator-cuff-A仅是旧目录明确肩部稳定目标替代，其双侧plank抬手模式与本侧撑髋下沉不同，不冒充等价剂量或直接降阶。没有经验证的膝支撑侧平板独立ID。
顶峰下沉与回升起点同为2.1秒，三相位是可选引导句，不是可同时播放的音轨；重复点按真实4.4/5.9/7.4时间单列，不伪造4秒等周期。
本稿保留旧目录剂量数字和范围。rhythm描述真实8秒示范，不把短演示循环当作已完成持续时间处方；需要专业编辑确认播放/计数。
主要/协同肌群含姿势稳定或次要拉伸角色，未作肌电定量结论；动作关系是现有ID候选，不能自动消费旧模型媒体。
通用禁用筛查依据catalog/v2/definition-evidence.md及AAOS髋/脊柱康复资料；具体到各动作的应用是待审编辑推断，没有疾病特异绝对禁忌或临床适用性批准。
